name: Design for Systems Transformation
description: This course enables students to design interventions that are not only creative and human-centered but also system-aware and scalable. It equips students with tools from systems thinking, design research, and impact-oriented frameworks to tackle real-world, complex challenges — from climate resilience to public health to circular economy.
